description: React component for managing price data reloads, including manual refresh, scheduling periodic reloads, and displaying reload status.

methods.name: fetchReloadStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current reload status from the backend and updates state.

methods.name: handleHardRefresh
methods.description: Triggers an immediate reload of price data and updates status.

methods.name: handleScheduleReload
methods.description: Schedules periodic reloads based on user input.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a date-time string into a locale-specific string or 'Never' if null.

methods.name: getStatusText
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current reload status.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a color string representing the reload status.
